Design Review & Verification Procedure
Structural engineering consultancy · high-rise reinforced concrete buildings
Purpose
Ensures every structural deliverable is reviewed and verified against project requirements, applicable Indian Standards, client specifications and the organization's quality management system before submission.
Scope
Design Basis Reports, ETABS structural analysis models, SAFE foundation models, structural design calculations, general arrangement and reinforcement drawings, foundation design, design reports, and Tender / GFC / IFC structural drawings.
Responsibilities
PositionResponsibility
Design EngineerPrepares the structural model, calculations and drawings; self-checks before submission.
Checker / Senior Structural EngineerIndependent review of calculations, analytical models and drawings.
Lead Structural EngineerTechnical review of structural system, design philosophy, and comment closure.
Principal Structural EngineerFinal technical verification and approval for issue.
Review stages
1
Design input review — architectural background, DBR, soil report, wind tunnel report, client design criteria, IS codes, material specs
2
Structural analysis model review — geometry, modelling (slabs, beams, columns, walls, transfer structures), material/section properties, boundary conditions, load combinations, P-Delta
3
Loading review — gravity loads, lateral loads (wind, seismic, accidental eccentricity), long-term effects (creep, shrinkage, differential shortening)
4
Structural analysis review — modal analysis, base shear, drift limits, torsional/vertical irregularity, stability, foundation reactions
5
Structural design review — slabs, beams, columns, walls, transfer structures, foundations against IS 456, IS 875, IS 1893, IS 13920, IS 16700
6
Structural drawing review — layouts, member sizes, reinforcement details, sections, general notes, revision history, consistency with calculations
7
Final verification — all comments closed, calculations complete, models approved, drawings coordinated, code requirements satisfied, final approval obtained

Import employee details from Saral

Name, Employee ID, Designation, Department, Branch, Reporting manager and — where present in the file — Date of birth, Date of joining, PAN, Mobile, Email, Bank account, IFSC, PF No, ESI No and UAN are all read in automatically and populate the employee master directory.
